technology_name: A METHOD FOR SYNTHESIZING BIODEGRADABLE HYDROGEL FERTILIZER FOR CONTROLLED RELEASE AND EFFICIENT MATRIX NUTRIENT UTILIZATION
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard chemical crop fertilizers leach heavily into local groundwater tables during rainfall events, causing down-river eutrophication and massive material waste.
description: A chemical manufacturing process to synthesize a fully biodegradable, non-toxic bio-polymeric matrix hydrogel that locks in vital plant nutrients and releases them slowly matching crop growth cycles across 40 days.
applications: Sustainable commercial agriculture farms, specialized horticulture greenhouse matrices, topsoil erosion remediation plots, and drought-resistant crop cultivation zones.
secondary_sector: Advanced Materials & Chemical, Energy, Climate & Sustainability, Water, Environment & Waste Management, Agribusiness & Rural Economy
